card_title: [BUILD] Ayumi: Discord webhook notification on trade creation (signal details)
scope_check: pass — all 4 files are within the allowed_files intent (src/forex_bot/... for code, tests/... for tests, .env.example is the env contract). Card notes use a generic <feature>.py placeholder; concrete implementation lives under src/forex_bot/adapters/ctrader/ which is the documented trade-creation integration point.

integration_smoke.command: PYTHONPATH=src/forex_bot python3 -c 'from adapters.ctrader.trade_logger import TradeLogger; from adapters.ctrader.discord_notifier import DiscordNotifier; import tempfile; td=tempfile.mkdtemp(); tl=TradeLogger(log_dir=td, strategy_name="smoke"); assert tl._notifier is not None and not tl._notifier.enabled; explicit=DiscordNotifier(webhook_url="https://x", enabled=False); tl2=TradeLogger(log_dir=td, strategy_name="smoke", notifier=explicit); assert tl2._notifier is explicit; print("OK")'
integration_smoke.result: OK — TradeLogger constructs cleanly with both auto-instantiated and explicit notifier paths

acceptance_criteria_met.1_live_trade_posts_signal_fields: WIRED — TradeLogger.log_trade_opened() now calls _notify_trade_opened() after flushing the CSV record; payload embeds symbol/direction/volume/entry/SL/TP/strategy/timestamp/timeframe/comment. Live integration pending the next signal that passes regime-gate (not part of this card — see card ce7d3af0 for trace protocol).
acceptance_criteria_met.2_notification_failure_does_not_affect_e: PASS — Three tests cover this: test_notify_returns_immediately_when_post_fails (URLError swallowed), test_notify_handles_http_error_without_retry (4xx logged + dropped, not retried), test_notify_uses_fire_and_forget_thread (caller returns in <500ms while POST blocks 3s on background thread). Defensive try/except in TradeLogger._notify_trade_opened too.
acceptance_criteria_met.3_webhook_url_absent_silently_disables: PASS — test_notifier_is_disabled_when_url_absent + test_notify_is_noop_when_disabled_and_warns_once (single warning via class-level flag + threading.Lock).
acceptance_criteria_met.4_unit_tests_for_payload_and_isolation: PASS — 10 tests, no live trading affected (all use unittest.mock.patch on urllib).
acceptance_criteria_met.5_webhook_url_not_logged: PASS — code path never logs the URL; only logs status codes and a generic 'DISCORD_WEBHOOK is not set' message.
acceptance_criteria_met.6_scheme_allowlist: BONUS — _validate_webhook_url rejects non-http(s) schemes at init time; misconfigured env cannot redirect notifications to file:// or other schemes.

merge_pattern: git checkout main && git merge --no-ff autodev/ayumi-discord-webhook -m 'Merge Discord webhook trade notifications (card 21bf4320, Rin APPROVE iter-N)'
scope_caveat: Card allowed_files was a placeholder ('src/forex_bot/<feature>.py'); this commit materialises the actual paths. If Himari/Ava wants the allowed_files tightened, the next card can add specific paths to a child card.
